app_tagline: Learn anything with an AI tutor.
storage_not_persistent_body: This browser context cannot keep data (a private window, or no support for local storage). Your sessions and key are lost when you close the page.
home_topic_label: What do you want to learn?
home_sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Start one above.
home_need_key_title: Add your API key to start
home_need_key_body: kd-learn runs on your own model key. The key stays on this device.
settings_endpoint_gone: The server no longer offers this endpoint. Choose another one.
settings_endpoints_failed: Could not load the endpoint list from the server.
settings_model_description: The model name exactly as the provider spells it.
settings_key_description: Stored only in this browser. It is sent to the server with each turn so the server can call the provider, and the server does not keep it.
settings_key_saved_hint: A key is saved on this device. Leave this empty to keep it.
settings_missing: Enter a model and a key.
learn_not_found: This session does not exist on this device.
learn_broken: The saved log of this session is damaged: {reason}
plan_phase_probing: Getting to know what you already know
turn_interrupted_body: Your answer is saved. Send it again to continue.
turn_elsewhere: This turn is running in another tab.
error_Network: The connection was lost before the turn ended. Your answer is saved.
error_NoKey: Add a model and an API key in settings first.
error_Busy: Another tab is running this turn.
error_InvalidLog: The saved lesson does not accept this change.
error_HistoryTooLarge: This session has grown too long to send to the model. Start a new session to keep learning this topic.
error_UnknownEndpoint: The endpoint you chose is no longer available. Choose another one in settings.
error_provider_rejected: The provider rejected the request. Check the key and the model in settings.
skip_hint: You have spent a while on this step. You can move on.
done_body: You went through every step of this topic.
side_hint: Quick questions here stay out of the main lesson.
account_load_failed: Could not load from the server: {reason}
account_need_roles_title: Choose a model for each role
account_need_roles_body: Add a connection (a provider key, or an agent the admin enabled) and pick the model of the tutor roles in settings.
admin_only: Only an admin can open this page.
admin_guest_mode_hint: Learners use their own key; sessions stay on their device.
admin_demo_mode_hint: Anyone can try the app on the server's key, within the budget below.
admin_demo_used: {used} of {limit} model calls used in this period.
admin_demo_model: Demo model: {model} (set in the server environment).
admin_demo_no_model: No demo model is set in the server environment (KD_LEARN_DEMO_*).
admin_demo_closed: Demo mode is on but closed: it needs a budget above 0 and a demo model.
admin_demo_limit_hint: For every demo user together. 0 closes the demo.
admin_acp_hint: An enabled agent runs on this server's own login and subscription. Enable it only for a server with a few trusted users.
admin_acp_unavailable_title: This server build does not include ACP
admin_acp_unavailable_body: Turns through an enabled agent will fail. Build with KD_BUILD_ACP=1, or turn the agents off.
admin_acp_models_hint: Comma separated. Learners can only pick these; empty allows none.
admin_invites_hint: A code works once and expires after 72 hours. It is shown only now.
auth_password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
auth_invite_hint: This server only accepts new accounts with an invite code from its admin.
auth_no_accounts: This server runs without accounts. Use guest mode instead.
auth_error_TooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth_error_RegistrationClosed: This server does not accept new accounts.
auth_error_InvalidInvite: The invite code is not valid, already used or expired.
auth_error_EmailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
auth_error_InvalidRequest: Check the email address and the password (at least 8 characters).
connections_hint: A key is stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
connection_key_hint: Sent once to the server, which keeps it encrypted.
connection_missing: Fill in every field of the connection.
connection_agent_hint: Runs on the server's own login. No key needed.
roles_hint: The Prober finds out what you know, the Teacher runs the lesson, side chat answers quick questions.
roles_acp_models_hint: The models the admin allows for this agent.
roles_acp_no_models: The admin allows no model for this agent yet.
roles_incomplete: {role}: choose both a connection and a model.
roles_copy: Use the Prober's choice for every role
demo_banner_body: It runs on the server's key with a shared budget. Sessions stay on this device.
error_RoleNotConfigured: Choose a connection and a model for this role in settings.
error_KeyUnreadable: The saved key can no longer be read. Add the connection again in settings.
error_AcpAgentDisabled: The admin has not enabled this agent. Choose another connection in settings.
error_AcpModelNotAllowed: The admin does not allow this model for the agent. Choose an allowed one in settings.
error_AcpBusy: Every agent on the server is busy. Try again in a moment.
error_AcpUnavailable: This server cannot run agents. Ask the admin, or choose another connection.
error_TurnInProgress: A turn is already running in this session.
error_TurnTimeout: The model took too long to answer.
error_DemoQuotaExceeded: The demo has used up its turns for now. Try again later, or use your own key.
error_DemoModeDisabled: The demo is closed on this server.
error_GuestModeDisabled: Guest mode is closed on this server. Sign in to keep learning.
welcome_title: How do you want to learn?
welcome_account_body: Your sessions live on this server and keep running when you close the tab.
welcome_guest_body: No account. Your key and sessions stay on this device.
welcome_demo_body: No key needed: it runs on the server's key, with a limited number of turns.
welcome_nothing: This server offers no way in right now.
